076e0067-6d4b-4392-9846-0d758d039177.author: xqjG
076e0067-6d4b-4392-9846-0d758d039177.content: DIRECTIVE (2026-07-22, mid-flow): both cores are planned for removal — mdatron-core and vsdd-core. CLASSIFICATION: spec-amendment-adjacent plan information; scope read as the standing structural intent, with scheduling and the workspace question open. WHAT IT CHANGES IN THIS BUNDLE: (1) the engine-reuse language dies — the boundary is tool-to-tool: mdatron is invoked over the markdown estate at action and boundary time; no consumer builds on a library seam. (2) vsdd's read-time validation transition gets explicit: the contract already frames vsdd's read-time schema validation as BOOTSTRAP ('schema-validated at read by vsdd during bootstrap, by mdatron's conformance families once landed'), so the mdatron-core link was always transitional — end-state is vsdd's own light shape checks (the serde typed decode IS a shape check, plus schema_class identity) with the mdatron CLI as the authoritative walker at commit and CI, and the YAML state file validated by vsdd's own code entirely (already true at write; the read-time schema-pair call is the piece that migrates off the library). The jsonschema-crate alternative stays a PE decision if deeper read-time validation proves needed (the #723 residue's dependency class). (3) The contract's workspace-shape paragraph ('superseded for vsdd — the cost crate requires a workspace') takes an amendment when the collapse schedules; OPEN SUB-QUESTIONS, decision-needed at scheduling, not now: does the cost crate keep the vsdd workspace with the binary crate, and does mdatron's single crate keep a lib target — the latter is the mdatron cycle's call, and this estate should not depend on it either way. The two boundary texts update this turn; the collapse itself is not scheduled by this record.

1b83b6f1-6805-4bca-8e1f-1f32c0ff8769.author: xqjG
1b83b6f1-6805-4bca-8e1f-1f32c0ff8769.content: DRAFT, the vsdd side (three touches, one window; ratification is the operator's): (1) TIER CLAUSE, Trust boundaries or Conformance at action time: a schema or pattern pass is a shape fact about an artifact, never a truth fact about the system — truth-tier verdicts come only from evidence-consuming machinery (gates, the corroboration join, hash bindings); state semantics (transitions, write-time constraints, the derivation) never encode into schema pairs. Falsification: a semantic transition rule found encoded in a schema pair; a record treating a verify pass as gate evidence. Upstream precedent: Thermite doc-drift decision 5 (the thermite-state-architecture knowledge page). (2) STATE-VALIDATION RE-HOME, Conformance at action time + the phase-state resolution's executor lines: mdatron's scope is the markdown artifact estate (the operator's 2026-07-22 scope ruling: Schematron for Markdown with rust-like errors for agent-first workflows); the state artifact is YAML, so its shape validation is vsdd's own at read and write (consuming mdatron-core's engine as a library — engine reuse, not scope creep), and the state-consistency family's evidence joins (state versus gate records, tracker, git) are vsdd integrity machinery (Layer 2's snapshot-scoped checks and the gates), not an mdatron family; mdatron's Layer 7 integration narrows to the markdown-side families: routes, pins, vocabulary and register, cross-file patterns. (3) PROSE-RESTATEMENT RULE, the artifact-authoring conduct (data-side companion in the registry prose): governed-artifact prose never restates counts or enumerations the frontmatter carries — cite the field, do not copy the value (the #684/#685 drift class; Thermite prevents it by generating views; our correction is authorial until a numeric-claims pattern exists). Drafts land in the tree at the window; the window rides Layer 2's amend-then-act path with the queued items.

2341945f-522c-4cf9-a6b3-28bb753afa07.title: upstream crosslink: init --update clobbers adopter customizations inside the managed .gitignore block without warning
2341945f-522c-4cf9-a6b3-28bb753afa07.description: Observed in this repo's 2026-07-20 install repair: the root .gitignore's crosslink-managed block carried a deliberate, comment-documented adopter customization (carve-outs keeping vsdd-prefixed artifacts in .claude/hooks|commands|mcp tracked as source — this repo IS the toolkit those directories deploy from). init --update replaced the block with the canonical form silently: no warning, no diff surfaced, no refusal — in a tool whose own managed-file discipline elsewhere is drift-refusal. per-field width budgets with the (cut) mark set off by a space and the milestone name truncating before the count; worded absences from the data; the degraded marker as the kind's plain marker word; no session field; deterministic byte-for-byte; color as optional decoration only. vsdd/src/status/human.rs — the PURE human form: TWO SECTIONS per the adopted facets note — the answer (position: phase, layer, next action, composition) and the report (health: degraded kind with its full next-step text, integrity findings, substrate findings); superset of every segment field plus the session rendering (the demotion ruling); broken-state renders the rustc-shaped diagnostic with per-kind recovery, its grammar aligned to mdatron's exact rendering shape (the boundary-sweep disposition, executed here). vsdd/src/status/machine.rs — the PURE machine form: named blocks answer and report; broken-state is the structured state-unreadable signal (enumerated kind, diagnostic payload, recovery action from the vocabulary); superset-of-segment verified. vsdd/src/status/broken.rs — the shared broken-state composition, carrying #740: the last-boundary truth (the most recent boundary commit's subject from a bounded git log query — a new pub seam in vsdd-core's shell since the runner is core-internal) rendered as recovery context on the human and machine forms; absence of a boundary commit is a worded absence, never a failure. vsdd/src/status/instruments.rs — the conduct seams: the counting stdin wrapper (the statusline path reads zero bytes; the sentinel fixture backs the count), the acquisition counter, the whole-invocation wall-clock against the 250ms budget with the 7-run median and twice-budget ceiling; model-absence is the test environment's property (no credentials, no network), documented not coded. vsdd/src/status/multi.rs — the composed multi-repo display over the explicit repo-set config ({repos, per_repo_budget_ms} at the registered location): one segment line per repo, current first, per-line worded repo identity, every single-segment conduct check holding per line. templates/statusline/vsdd-statusline.sh — the wiring script (installed by Layer 4, authored here): reads the repo-set config, invokes the composed display, passes the substrate's stdin through unconsumed, aggregate cost denominated repo-count-times-per-repo-budget; ownership and drift refusal per the managed-file discipline; the non-wrapper composition instruction ships beside it per the registered conduct.

13db2503-f2d3-4846-b3f9-2aa0c4dc16c6.author: xqjG
13db2503-f2d3-4846-b3f9-2aa0c4dc16c6.content: LAYER 1 CRATE-LEVEL MODULE MAP (the layer's phase-2a design act; attended, this session). Home: vsdd-core, beside the existing schema-bundle modules. NEW MODULES: (1) diagnostics.rs — the rustc-shaped Diagnostic both new modules emit: file, failure kind, location when the failure is a parse, message, recovery action (machine token) and recovery text (human) — kinds and recovery members LOADED from the statusline data set at runtime, never hardcoded, because the kind-to-action mapping is versioned data. (2) state/ — mod.rs public API (State, read_state -> Result<State, Diagnostic>, write_state with boundary evidence); schema.rs the State struct mirroring state-schema.md's state_fields verbatim (schema_version, nullable current_phase and current_layer with the pinned null meanings, open_findings_pointer, optional last_gate_result with the closed gate-kind enum, active_composition with config_inputs_hash, optional forward-only published); read.rs effectful read wrapping a PURE validate-bytes core — bootstrap self-validation gates on schema_version before further reads; the three read-failure kinds map exactly to statusline-data's enumeration, diagnostic-never-panic on every path; write.rs atomic write (temp-plus-rename, no partial file survives) with the PURE published-immutability check (a diff touching published after first write is refused) and the declared constraints re-checked at write. (3) registry/ — mod.rs load_all yielding the nine typed sets keyed by schema_class, each validated against its .mdatron/schemas pair at read via mdatron-core (the boundary: vsdd supplies schemas, mdatron executes; self-validation until the state-consistency family lands); frontmatter.rs PURE markdown-with-frontmatter extraction with parse-location capture; sets.rs one typed struct per schema_class, field names mirroring the artifacts. PURITY BOUNDARIES per the verification architecture: parse, validate, and the immutability check are pure over bytes and values — the property and mutation targets; file IO is effectful shell, integration-tested. TRUST BOUNDARY: state.yaml and the registry are adopter-edited — every read failure yields the diagnostic, never a panic. TEST SURFACE the red gate authors against: state read (happy, absent, malformed-with-location, permission-denied, future-schema-version refused, pinned null semantics), state write (atomicity under injected failure, published immutability, evidence required), registry (all nine load from the live tree; corrupted frontmatter diagnostic; class mismatch diagnostic), diagnostics (machine form carries the loaded tokens; human form rustc-shaped; every failure path returns).

503becf2-c3b7-45f2-a412-192fd8a1828f.title: Consolidate parallel design tree: fold mdatron methodology-process docs back into vsdd-cli + crosslink
503becf2-c3b7-45f2-a412-192fd8a1828f.description:
Current state: 

Desired state: 

Reason: 

## What

I authored a parallel methodology-process layer in the mdatron repo (BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE, V1-SHIP-CRITERIA, BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION, STEP-2-SCOPE, dsl-falsifiability-report, .vsdd/events/, "Step 0.5 / Step 1 / Step 2" framing) that is parallel to vsdd-cli's own design tree. Operator diagnosed it correctly: the workstream should have been driven by VSDD's phase primers + crosslink's issue/knowledge substrate; instead I created an invented coordination layer that is now creating confusion.

## Why this is tracked rather than fixed now

Per operator directive 2026-06-01: "Mark as cleanup; continue current work; revisit after Phase A.1 lands." mdatron's Phase A.1 foundational work (JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, etc.) is the priority; consolidation cleanup follows.

## What the cleanup entails

When this issue activates:

1. DESIGN-MDATRON.md: relocate to vsdd-cli/ as a sibling DESIGN doc alongside DESIGN-SCHEMA.md, DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md, etc. OR keep in mdatron as a subsystem-internal spec — operator decides.
2. BOUNDARY-PREAMBLE.md: 8 declarations scattered to where they logically belong in vsdd-cli's existing docs (substrate composition, binary surface, cross-doc graph, artifact class split, install order — most already mirrored at Step 0.5).
3. V1-SHIP-CRITERIA.md: fold into vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY OR file as a crosslink milestone for v1.0 ship.
4. BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION.md: the generic bootstrap-period methodology pattern belongs in vsdd-cli/DESIGN-METHODOLOGY as a sanctioned discipline. Specific mitigations either retire or become crosslink issues.
5. STEP-2-SCOPE.md: retire as a scratchpad. Remaining work items become crosslink issues.
6. .vsdd/events/*.yaml on both repos: replaced by crosslink session events when event-emission tooling lands. Until then, composition declarations go in commit messages per BOOTSTRAP-MITIGATION § Mitigation 3 literal reading.
7. mdatron repo final shape: Cargo workspace + README pointing to vsdd-cli for canonical design + CHANGELOG + LICENSE. No methodology-process docs of its own.

## Going forward (process)

- crosslink issues drive trackable work
- crosslink knowledge pages hold canonical content (per the existing vsdd-cli pattern)
- vsdd-cli's existing DESIGN docs absorb mdatron-related content where appropriate
- mdatron repo stays minimal: Rust code + thin README

## Acceptance criteria

- mdatron repo contains only: Cargo.toml, mdatron-core/, mdatron-cli/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE, target/ (gitignored)
- vsdd-cli design docs absorb the load-bearing content from the deleted mdatron process docs
- Going-forward work tracked via crosslink issues, not standalone markdown scope artifacts

## Trigger

Revisit after mdatron Phase A.1 (foundational engine: JSON Schema dispatch, DSL parser, cross-file index, error catalog loader, 5 built-in patterns) is sufficiently mature that the parallel-design-tree pollution becomes the bottleneck.

078dd7ad-a3be-49de-b680-10fda4958d8b.content: THIRD MDATRON RAISE (operator-caught 2026-07-22, correcting the crosslink strict-YAML item's routing): the design.md defect ALSO goes to mdatron, and it is the more structural of the two. The crosslink side (ship valid YAML) fixes one file; the mdatron side fixes the class. RAISE 3 — SCOPING / IGNORE LIST: mdatron walks every frontmatter-bearing markdown in the tree, including files it neither owns nor should govern — chassis-deployed command files, third-party artifacts. A malformed third-party file therefore blocks the CONSUMER's commits over a document mdatron has no mandate to validate. Passes the three-question gate: in scope (which markdown mdatron validates is core Schematron-for-markdown territory), unsupported today (it walks all), generic (any consumer with third-party-deployed markdown wants it). Asks: a route-table-style ALLOWLIST (mdatron validates only what a consumer explicitly routes — Thermite's spec-routes.toml is the precedent, and the estate's own contract already carries a closed-world route table as a first-class concept) OR an IGNORE LIST as the lighter interim; plus a stated default (walk-all vs route-only) — the route-only default is the closed-world-correct one. This retires the design.md incident's whole class: with routing, an unrouted chassis command file is simply not mdatron's to refuse. The crosslink filing stays drafted (ship valid YAML regardless); the mdatron raise is the durable fix. Relay text for carriage delivered in-session alongside raises 1 and 2.

abeafec1-2f39-4886-8522-3bb2613a7df8.title: Respec: agent-first VSDD toolkit on the crosslink chassis (fresh design cycle)
abeafec1-2f39-4886-8522-3bb2613a7df8.description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

Fresh design cycle superseding the 2026-05 design corpus (4 DESIGN-*.md docs + binary-first plan #11-#17), initiated by operator 2026-07-18 after a five-dataset evaluation (bookmark-cli-manual, issue-tracker-cli, #12/#13 cycles, vsdd-suite self-reviews, vsdd-cli/wip review-logs), a read of the VSDD/VDD whitepapers, crosslink governing docs, and the Thermite harness (ACToR).

Mandate: vsdd-cli becomes the methodology layer installed into crosslink's seams (rules, skills, hooks, gates, swarm); mdatron stays the artifact-conformance engine invoked at action time; delivery is agent-first (context + constraints + hooks; binaries are organs, not the product).

Operator decisions recorded: agent-side interpretation; determinism in the process, not the tool; crosslink is the required chassis (two-mode parity retired); provably = in-flight gating AND after-the-fact audit; phase state = written artifact; Red Gate = keep and mechanize (red suite provably fails against pre-implementation commit; mutation floors; critic post-hoc tests); no coinages / plain names.

Core behavioral contracts to author in Phase 1a: deterministic phase answer ('what phase are we in'); directive reconciliation (every mid-flow operator directive classified — Phase 4 routing / spec amendment / recorded override + re-entry path — before execution; silent execution is a named defect); phase-exit by verifiable gate, not assertion; finding lifecycle state lives in crosslink alone (findings filed in subject repo's tracker); composition = activation axes keyed on artifact surfaces with pairs preserved and mechanically separated (validator lifecycle, no self-validation).

Deliverables: lean methodology.md (process spec) + toolkit DESIGN.md (implementation contract), authored in .design/ per chassis convention.

ac5fb15a-15e3-4fa6-ae9d-d4d542b8f174.title: c1 major SE+security convergent: write_state is check-then-act — the exists()/read window skips the forward-only published check
ac5fb15a-15e3-4fa6-ae9d-d4d542b8f174.description: Evidence: write.rs:61-70 gates the prior read on path.exists(); a file created between exists()==false and the rename clobbers a written published block (the headline immutability invariant, enforced nowhere else); exists() also returns false on stat errors, taking the same skipped path; a file deleted after exists()==true leaks READ-vocabulary tokens (restore-state-file) out of the WRITE API; security's TOCTOU nit converges (two concurrent writers on fresh .vsdd both skip the guard). Disposition: drop exists() — one fs::read up front, NotFound = no-prior, other IO errors map to write-shaped refusals; document or lock the remaining read-to-rename lost-update window. Owner: software-engineer. Validator: security.

34a6a93f-9fb3-41cf-8a8e-e407e2d4fc06.content: LAYER 2 CRATE-LEVEL MODULE MAP (the design act). Home: vsdd-core beside Layer 1. NEW MODULES: (1) snapshot/ — mod.rs the Snapshot struct mirroring snapshot-schema's snapshot_fields verbatim (acquisition_outcome enum acquired|absent|unusable; milestones, findings, round_manifests, round_children, comment_handles, the four display fields); acquire.rs the EFFECTFUL acquisition building the snapshot from the chassis's query surface — one acquisition per invocation, absent and unusable outcomes never panic (the count-conduct instruments join at Layer 3). (2) answer/ — mod.rs the PhaseAnswer struct (phase, layer, next_action from the vocabulary, active composition echo, degraded kind, integrity findings at the kind-set grain); derive.rs the PURE derivation (State, Snapshot, the loaded registry data) -> PhaseAnswer — deterministic, degraded exactly when the outcome is absent or unusable with the kind never swapped, null phase mapping to the enter action, fix-lane tokens excluded from the output domain per the #689 ruling; integrity.rs the PURE snapshot-scoped checks, the audit's six less the degraded-kind check (which is the derivation's own enforced property): round-parity, unresolvable handles, findings missing owner or validator, closed findings missing evidence, phase pointer against milestone state. (3) integrity_shell/ — refs.rs the off-grammar query: a PURE membership core over injected ref names consuming the registered branch grammar (both forms plus exempt refs), the git listing in the shell; substrate.rs the session-substrate check over the installed-artifact manifest — three-valued fail-closed per entry by its resolution field, plus the project-root-equals-repo-root member. PURITY: derive, integrity, and refs membership are pure property targets; acquisition, git listing, and filesystem resolution are shell. DEPENDENCY, PE-FLAGGED: the regex crate — the branch grammar's registered patterns are regex strings in versioned data, and hand-rolling a matcher would reimplement what the data declares; investigation note follows with the suite. DATA-SHAPE PREREQUISITE, found by this design act: dispatch-data's exempt refs live in rules PROSE while this layer's refs query consumes them as data — the #688-adopted set promotes to a structured exempt_refs field under the pair rule (data-side mechanical, the adopted content unchanged), and sets.rs types branch_grammar per its Layer 2 deepening annotation. e516ac4b-d705-4c66-b9ce-666cde3aae99.title: upstream crosslink: hub-sync ID promotion strands session work pointer and lock table on provisional IDs
e516ac4b-d705-4c66-b9ce-666cde3aae99.description: Observed during the 2026-07-20 first hub sync of this repo (crosslink 0.8.0): sync promoted 359 offline issues to display IDs and reported 'Updated 76 reference(s) (comments: 60, descriptions: 15, sessions: 1)', but immediately after, 'crosslink session status' showed 'Working on: L272 (issue not found)' and 'crosslink locks list' showed both active locks as '(unknown issue)' keyed to the dead provisional IDs (L1, L272) — the promoted issues are #294 and #597. The reference updater covers comments, descriptions, and session records but not the lock table or the session's work pointer, so a mid-work sync severs the session's own binding. Repair performed by hand: locks released, work re-claimed via 'crosslink session work 597'. Suggestion: include the lock table and session work pointer in the same renumbering pass; a lock or work pointer referencing a promoted provisional ID after sync should be impossible by construction. Evidence: this session's sync transcript, 2026-07-20, recorded on vsdd-cli #597's trail. Joins the upstream findings list (pattern of #430-#433, #237).

f520f33c-cb37-4154-b9a5-1c5a9d164cce.title: round 1 operator-observed: calibration bands carry no token dimension — first live round runs 350-450k downstream tokens against a band that cannot express it
f520f33c-cb37-4154-b9a5-1c5a9d164cce.description: Operator-observed during round 1's live dispatch (2026-07-21), watching the harness agent monitor. Evidence: the round-1 manifest on #673 declared its expected band as 'cold-spec-review-round, 3 to 15 findings' — the adopted band (economics-data.md, calibration_bands) is denominated in findings and wall-clock only; the contract's cost denomination ('tokens by cache class' among the native units) has no member in the band data. Observed actuals, capture-source harness task telemetry: quality-engineer lens 71,732 tokens; ux lens 50,948; the three remaining lenses at 70.7k-111.9k mid-run per the operator's monitor — roughly 350-450k downstream tokens for one five-lens round, in an estate whose amendment history runs 8-22 rounds. Root shape: each cold lens independently reads its domain prompt, governing-contract sections, and all nine artifacts — five uncached contexts, input-dominated. Disposition candidates for triage (operator has not yet ruled): (a) add a token dimension to the bands now, seeded from these first actuals; (b) leave bands as-is and let Layer 9's ledger own the dimension, recording actuals per round meanwhile; (c) structural cost reduction for later rounds — per-set lens briefs over the retrieval-shaped artifacts instead of all-nine reads, fewer lenses per round per the review-budget rule; (d) re-denominate by what binds under the session's auth mode (window and operator-time), per the adopted attribution grain. Owner: ai-engineer. Validator: solution-owner (band data is operator-adopted oracle territory).

2bef229f-6a74-4a0a-b207-4de97f846fbd.author: xqjG
2bef229f-6a74-4a0a-b207-4de97f846fbd.content: DOCUMENTED PRICING WEIGHTS APPLIED TO OBSERVED USAGE (capture: transcript usage records; rates: Anthropic API documentation via the claude-api reference — Opus 4.8 $5/M input, $25/M output, cache read 0.1x input, cache write 1.25x input at 5-minute TTL): per-lens API-equivalent cost — solution-architect $6.25 (cache-write dominates: $4.06 of it), solution-owner $5.50, documentation-reviewer $4.68, quality-engineer $2.43, ux $1.94. ROUND TOTAL ~$20.80 API-equivalent (under this estate's subscription auth this expresses as window consumption, not billed dollars — the attribution-grain rule — but the documented weights are the canonical ranking). STRUCTURE: cache-write (context accumulation at 1.25x) and output (25x the cache-read rate) are the expensive units; the headline multi-million cache-read numbers are the CHEAP unit (0.1x). The levers, re-ranked by documented weights: (1) context accumulated per lens (cache-write), (2) output volume incl. thinking, (3) turn count (drives cache-read AND re-writes). MODEL TIER, observed + documented: the five lenses ran claude-opus-4-8 ($5/$25); the session model (claude-fable-5) is documented at $10/$50 — exactly 2x per token. The harness already routes fan-outs to the cheaper tier; the same round on the session model would have weighed ~$41.60. Model-per-dispatch is a 2x lever and our manifest had recorded it wrong (see the #673 correction). EFFORT, documented: Claude Code defaults to xhigh on this tier; effort controls thinking depth and overall token spend (lower = fewer, more consolidated tool calls — the turn-count driver we measured); thinking bills as output tokens; the Workflow orchestration surface exposes per-agent effort (opts.effort) while the plain fan-out tool does not — so effort-controlled A/B rounds are ALREADY POSSIBLE via the workflow vehicle, a capability note for the measured-pass design.

6cfc32a9-48c8-407a-9196-4b20f2d922a1.author: xqjG
6cfc32a9-48c8-407a-9196-4b20f2d922a1.content: OBSERVED MAKEUP, round 1 (capture source: subagent transcript usage records, parsed by the bootstrap adapter script this comment describes — the transcripts carry per-request input/output/cache-read/cache-write): solution-architect 15.3k uncached-in / 1.65M cache-read / 650k cache-write / 51.4k out, 39 api turns, tools 22 Read + 2 Bash; solution-owner 15.3k / 3.75M / 402k / 41.3k, 56 turns, 15 Bash + 14 Read; documentation-reviewer 27.3k / 2.65M / 354k / 40.3k, 62 turns, 22 Bash + 11 Read; quality-engineer 19.0k / 472k / 235k / 25.0k, 22 turns, 10 Read; ux 18.5k / 1.10M / 104k / 25.9k, 47 turns, 17 Bash + 5 Read. THE OPTIMIZATION SIGNAL (the operator's tool-mix hypothesis confirmed): cache-read volume tracks API TURN COUNT, not artifact size — every tool call triggers a full-context cache re-read, so the 56-turn Bash-heavy solution-owner lens moved 3.75M cache tokens while the 22-turn Read-only quality-engineer lens moved 472k for comparable finding yield. Turn count and tool mix are the levers; uncached input is trivial (15-27k) and output modest (25-51k) everywhere. CAPTURE DISCREPANCY, recorded per the provenance discipline: the harness notification figure (e.g. quality-engineer 71,732) matches no simple combination of the transcript usage fields — two capture sources, two numbers, definitions to be pinned before either enters a band. Signal candidates for the effort/optimization catalog (AI Engineer owned): api-turn count per dispatch; tool-mix ratio (search-shaped Bash vs whole-file Read); cache-read per turn (context growth); cache-write (context accumulated); output per finding. Bootstrap adapter: a ~30-line transcript parser, run per round — no conduct change required to measure, per the operator's observe-first ruling.

f7d4a19d-8eeb-4979-852f-492e28744096.title: c1 minor collector: write-path hygiene and durability scope
f7d4a19d-8eeb-4979-852f-492e28744096.description: (1) SE+security convergent: the fixed dotfile temp name — failed fs::write leaves the partial temp behind (only the rename arm cleans up) and concurrent writers collide on the identical name; tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in + persist gives unique names and RAII cleanup (promote the existing dev-dependency). (2) SE: no fsync before rename — a crash can durably publish a truncated state.yaml; OPERATOR-SHAPED half: implement sync_all before rename, or narrow the module doc's claim to in-process failures for a git-tracked artifact (a scope ruling). (3) security: no byte bound on reads — serde_yaml_ng bounds amplification and nesting (probed: repetition and recursion limits fire) but a flat huge file is fully materialized pre-parse; a capped reader with a documented limit fails oversize fast. Owner: software-engineer. Validator: security.

The module doc states atomicity covers in-process failure orderings; crash durability is explicitly out of scope — the state artifact is boundary-committed and the read-failure discipline's restore-from-boundary recovery is the designed crash path. Items 1 and 3 keep their code-side dispositions (unique temp names via the promoted tempfile dependency; the capped reader).
